firm_data.firm_description: Tsyngauz & Associates, P.C. is a boutique law firm located in Downtown Manhattan specializing in complex real estate transactions and litigation matters. The firm's commitment to clients is linked by a focus on real estate and reshaping the skyline of New York City.
notable_facts: The firm has become a trusted advisor to major developers, businesses and individuals in NYC.
Yevgeny Tsyngauz has numerous published legal decisions.

email.subject: AI for Tsyngauz & Associates, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Yevgeny,

Your focus on reshaping NYC's skyline through complex real estate transactions and litigation is exactly the kind of specialized work that demands precision over volume. That's where most firms struggle as deals get more intricate.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Manhattan to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Downtown office to show how we're helping boutique firms compete with larger competitors on complex deals.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
